jumbotron.what: The screen that shows the crowd to the crowd
jumbotron.concept: A self-referential analytics page on primals.eco that shows live visitor data  country flags, request counts, wave numbers  so every visitor sees: we see you, and you are welcome
jumbotron.kiss_cam: Highlight one country per wave. Tell their story. Why they came. What they found.
jumbotron.goodyear_blimp: The blimp is the membrane itself  it floats above everything, sees everything, shows it to everyone below. CF analytics + Caddy logs + WG mesh + Tor circuits = omniscient observer that SHARES what it sees.
jumbotron.the_wave: In a stadium, the wave goes around the whole circle. 204 countries IS the wave. It already happened. We just need to show it.
